rules.name: ChickenPox_LymphNodes
rules.description: Matches mentions of lymph nodes combined with itching, swelling, or pain, which is specific to chicken pox in the provided data.
rules.label: chicken pox

rules.name: ChickenPox_RedSpots_Systemic
rules.description: Identifies explicit mentions of 'red spots', 'patches', or 'rashes' combined with any general systemic symptom or itching, as these are strong indicators not present in counter-examples. Priority increased to resolve conflict with typhoid.
rules.label: chicken pox

rules.name: ChickenPox_Rashes_Itch_NoNegs
rules.description: Matches general 'rashes', 'skin rash', or 'red patches' combined with itching, discomfort, swelling, or spreading, while employing negative lookaheads to explicitly exclude keywords associated with 'varicose veins', 'psoriasis', and 'typhoid' found in counter-examples. Updated to include singular 'rash'.
rules.label: chicken pox

rules.name: Psoriasis_SpecificSkinManifestations
rules.description: Matches highly specific skin descriptions characteristic of psoriasis, such as scaly spots, silvery film/powder, or peeling/flaking skin, especially on common affected areas like elbows and knees. Updated to handle 'elbows and knees' conjunction.
rules.label: psoriasis

rules.name: Psoriasis_NailIssues
rules.description: Identifies characteristic nail problems like small dents, pits, or strange inflammation, which are strong indicators of psoriatic nail disease.
rules.label: psoriasis

rules.name: Psoriasis_PalmsSolesFissures
rules.description: Detects specific skin conditions on palms and soles, such as severe fissures or cracks, which can be seen in forms of psoriasis like palmoplantar psoriasis.
rules.label: psoriasis

rules.name: Psoriasis_JointPainSymptoms
rules.description: Captures various descriptions of joint pain, often with strong adjectives (e.g., excruciating, extreme), which is a key symptom of psoriatic arthritis.
rules.label: psoriasis

rules.name: typhoid_gi_fever_combination
rules.description: Matches texts describing a combination of at least one core GI symptom (vomiting, nausea, diarrhea, constipation) and at least one systemic symptom or abdominal pain (fever, headache, abdominal/stomach pain).
rules.label: typhoid

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_VeinVisualSymptoms
rules.description: Matches direct mentions of veins or blood vessels being prominent, swollen, visible, or protruding on legs or calves.
rules.label: varicose veins

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_UnexplainedBruisingLegs
rules.description: Matches mentions of unexplained bruises or bruising specifically on the legs or calves.
rules.label: varicose veins

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_ActivityAggravatedLegDiscomfort
rules.description: Matches leg or calf pain, discomfort, cramps, or aching that is aggravated by prolonged standing or walking.
rules.label: varicose veins

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_LegCramps
rules.description: Matches mentions of cramps specifically located in the legs or calves, including pain similar to cramps.
rules.label: varicose veins

rules.name: ChickenPox_SystemicSymptoms
rules.description: Matches combinations of general systemic symptoms characteristic of chicken pox, such as fever/headache, fatigue/weakness, and loss of appetite, requiring at least two distinct categories of these symptoms.
rules.label: chicken pox

rules.name: ChickenPox_AppetiteLoss
rules.description: Matches mentions of significant loss of appetite or inability to eat, often a general early symptom of chicken pox when no other specific symptoms are present.
rules.label: chicken pox

rules.name: ChickenPox_FatigueEnergyLoss
rules.description: Matches general fatigue, lack of energy, or lethargy, which can be an early symptom of chicken pox.
rules.label: chicken pox

rules.name: Typhoid_SystemicAbdominal
rules.description: Matches a combination of systemic symptoms (fever, headache, chills, fatigue) and abdominal or stomach discomfort, even without explicit GI symptoms like diarrhea or vomiting. This broadens coverage for typhoid cases.
rules.label: typhoid

rules.name: VaricoseVeins_LegRashSymptoms
rules.description: Matches descriptions of a spreading, red, inflamed, or itchy rash specifically on the legs or calves, indicating a possible complication of varicose veins like venous eczema.
rules.label: varicose veins
